canonical_example.text: Het vogeltje bouwt zijn nest in het riet.
canonical_example.translation: The little bird builds its nest among the reeds.

meanings.translation: a nest (place to hatch young, especially bird structure)

canonical_example.text: Hij groeide op in een rood nest.
canonical_example.translation: He grew up in a left-wing household.

canonical_example.text: Wat een verwend nest!
canonical_example.translation: What a spoiled, pretentious brat!

unused_menu_senses.translation: a nasty, ill-behaving or pretentious child; a brat

canonical_example.text: Kom uit je nest, ’t is hoogste tijd!
canonical_example.translation: Get out of bed, it’s high time!

canonical_example.text: Mijn oom van vaders kant heeft drie nichten, waarvan er twee getrouwd zijn.
canonical_example.translation: My paternal uncle has three nieces, two of whom are married.

meanings.translation: niece; daughter of someone's brother- or sister-in-law

canonical_example.text: Mijn broer en zijn vrouw hebben twee nichten, een tweeling.
canonical_example.translation: My brother and his wife have two nieces, twins.

meanings.translation: niece; daughter of someone's brother or sister

canonical_example.text: Mijn nicht is een jaar jonger dan ik en we zijn goede vriendinnen.
canonical_example.translation: My female cousin is one year younger than me, and we are good friends.

unused_menu_senses.translation: female cousin; daughter of someone's uncle or aunt
male homosexual, a gay man; in particular one who is camp or effeminate

meanings.translation: radar (detection system operating by means of radio waves)

canonical_example.text: Medewerkers zijn enthousiast over de nieuwe strategie.
canonical_example.translation: Employees are excited about the new strategy.

unused_menu_senses.translation: one who is inspired or possessed by a deity; esp. one inspired by God

canonical_example.text: De roos Friesia verspreidt een hemels parfum.
canonical_example.translation: The rose Friesia gives out a heavenly scent.

canonical_example.text: Essence van rozen en diverse andere bloemen is zeer gegeerd voor natuurlijke parfums.
canonical_example.translation: Essence of roses and various others flowers is in high demand for natural perfumes.

meanings.translation: a perfume, a luxury product providing a fragrant scent

canonical_example.text: Ze komt over een uur.
canonical_example.translation: She's coming in an hour.

meanings.translation: an hour, a period of time

canonical_example.text: Het is twaalf uur.
canonical_example.translation: It is twelve o'clock.

canonical_example.text: Wat doe jij op dit uur nog wakker?
canonical_example.translation: What are you doing still awake at this hour?

unused_menu_senses.translation: the hour, the time of day

canonical_example.text: Mijn moeder drinkt graag sterke blonde trappistenbieren.
canonical_example.translation: My mother likes to drink strong blonde trappist beers.

meanings.translation: blond, fair; of light color (usually said about light hair color, but it can also refer to beer)

canonical_example.text: Dat was een beetje blond van me.
canonical_example.translation: That was a bit stupid of me.

meanings.translation: professional (relating to one's profession or work; in accordance with the demands and duties of one's profession)

canonical_example.text: Ik verspreid het diagram onder mijn collega's.
canonical_example.translation: I spread the diagram around among my colleagues.

unused_menu_senses.translation: calm; well-behaved, like an obedient child
an endearment similar to English sweetie or sweetheart
to sweeten, to make or become sweet

meanings.translation: bingo; expression to indicate that a hit has been landed or that one has an idea.
bingo; expression to claim a win in bingo.
bingo (a win in that game of chance)

canonical_example.text: Dus ik stond gisteren in de supermarkt en toen...
canonical_example.translation: So I was standing in supermarket yesterday and then...

meanings.translation: to be present, have a stand or location

canonical_example.text: Wat sta jij daar te koken?
canonical_example.translation: What are you cooking there?

meanings.translation: Forms a continuous aspect. Although it carries an implication of standing, this is vague and is not strictly required or emphasized.

canonical_example.text: In de grondwet staat dat het kabinet verantwoordelijk is voor het beleid en de koning onschendbaar is.
canonical_example.translation: In the constitution it says that the cabinet is responsible for governance and that the king is inviolable.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to say, to be written, to be said (to be indicated in written form)

canonical_example.text: Het staat je goed!
canonical_example.translation: It suits you!

canonical_example.text: In Holland staat een huis.
canonical_example.translation: In Holland there is a house.

unused_menu_senses.translation: to be, to be placed or located

canonical_example.text: Als hij daar naar binnen gaat, staat hem een grote verrassing te wachten.
canonical_example.translation: If he goes in there, a big surprise will be waiting for him.

unused_menu_senses.translation: Indicates a prospective outcome, or something that will happen in the near future
